messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P2 - livermore-enterprise private cluster experiencing model inference failures and high tail latency. Affected pool: livermore-prod (dedicated). Symptoms: 503 on /v1/generate, repeated model OOM evictions, increased queueing.

sarah-eng: ack — i'm oncall. jumping in now.

mike-sre: pulling logs from livermore-prod nodes. i see repeated evictions and rapid cycle of model loads/unloads. probable memory thrash.

simon-runtime: summary from initial trace: eviction churn for open-ggml-13b at 17:23UTC. KV cache misses spike -> cold starts -> request backlog. looks like a bunch of long-seq requests + concurrent calls. not a network issue.

mike-sre: logs:
```
2026-03-15T17:23:45Z host=gpu-12 evict model=open-ggml-13b size=68GB reason=memory_pressure
2026-03-15T17:24:02Z host=gpu-12 runtime request=9f2c status=500 reason=kv-cache-miss
2026-03-15T17:24:08Z host=gpu-14 load model=open-ggml-13b duration=12.4s
```

simon-runtime: mitigation option A: pin tenant to a low-memory safe variant (open-ggml-13b-safe-q4) to avoid heavy memory footprints. Option B: temporarily funnel heavy traffic to a smaller model for this tenant only. since this is a private deployment, hosted fallbacks aren't permitted — must use variants available in the private catalog.

priyanka-se: @jen-cs please confirm customer's tolerance for brief model quality regression. livermore ops prefers availability over 1-2% quality delta.

jen-cs: contacted livermore SREs in customer DM, they prefer availability. authorize soft downgrade for the next 2 hours.

simon-runtime: ok executing emergency routing override. plan:
1) create tenant-scoped override to force safe variant for model open-ggml-13b
2) reduce per-request max_tokens for this tenant to 512
3) enable aggressive KV cache retention for this tenant
4) monitor 5m p50/p95 and eviction counts

luis-sre: command I will run now:
```
redwoodctl override set --tenant livermore-enterprise --model open-ggml-13b --variant open-ggml-13b-safe-q4 --ttl 2h --reason 'emergency pin to stop eviction thrash'
redwoodctl config set --tenant livermore-enterprise --key inference.max_tokens --value 512
redwoodctl cache config --tenant livermore-enterprise --policy aggressive-prefix
```

sarah-eng: please also add a routing weight to favor dedicated pool nodes with more free memory (gpu-20, gpu-21). I'll push a temporary selector rule.

mike-sre: applying selector:
```
redwoodctl routing update --tenant livermore-enterprise --selector 'free_mem>80GB' --priority high
```

incident-bot: override created by luis-sre at 2026-03-15T17:31:12Z (id=ovr-7e4a). routing selector applied. config changes queued.

jen-cs: telling customer: 'We're routing Livermore traffic to a lower-footprint model variant and tightening request limits to restore availability; expect degraded response quality for ~2 hours. We'll update in 15m.' :megaphone: 

priyanka-se: monitoring graphs — eviction count dropping, p95 latency improving from 2.3s -> 700ms, error rate down from 8% -> 0.7%.

sarah-eng: nice. keep watch. set an alert for any eviction > 5/min in next hour.

mike-sre: created incident ticket RN-8421, added runbook note and commands executed. tagging for post-incident: runtime-team, infra.

jen-cs: customer acknowledged and said they'll hold major batch jobs until we confirm stability.

simon-runtime: next steps for remediation: schedule an offline capacity bump for livermore-prod or convert some models to quantized variants permanently. also add prompt-level token caps on heavy endpoints.

luis-sre: recording commands and timestamps in jira. will revert override after 2 hours or earlier if safe.

sarah-eng: if we see more thrash after revert — escalate to capacity planning to provision extra GPUs under Dedicated reserve.

priyanka-se: thanks team. looks stable for now. will follow up with a short RCA and capacity recommendation.

mike-sre: closing slack incident thread — ping here if anything spikes. :white_check_mark:
